blocks.text: Experience the Authentic Charm of Bali Lush
A Tranquil Sanctuary in Bali's Rice Bowl

Bali Lush is a cute little boutique resort set among a gorgeous valley of rice terraces and lush landscaping. With two acres of property, complete with vegetable gardens, fruit orchard and coconut palms waiting for you to explore. Our traditional antique teak wooden houses, brought directly from the central Java region, provide a peak into the traditional farming lifestyle of Bali. Our gorgeous guest houses are truly a home away from home hidden in the valleys of the Rice Bowl of Bali. Our village provides a truly unique opportunity to meet locals in their home environment.
Relax and Rejuvenate Amidst Lush Landscapes and Village Life

We offer our guests a chance to escape the crowds and kick back and relax in an environment that offers hiking, natural sight-seeing, and traditional village life set amongst the most beautiful rice terraces of Bali. 

Our eco retreat in Bali offers three gorgeous free-standing bungalows that include a perfect fusion of Indonesian architecture and modern western comforts. While we are passionate about providing an authentic experience, we don’t believe you have to sacrifice the comforts of home. Our guest rooms make sure you don’t have to.  

All our guest rooms include air conditioning, a mini bar, an in-room safe, flat screen TVs and DVD’s for those days you want to stay in.

Bali Lush is also available to host your own retreat.

Stay 4 Nights for the Price of 3, or 7 Nights for the Price of 5!

My family & I have been traveling around Bali & Indonesia for almost two decades.  Bali Lush is truly unique.  Set within breathtaking rice fields, the journey through villages, jungle & rice fields is what makes Bali a special destination.  We loved our cottage, totally authentic; all 5 of us were super comfortable and actually slept longer than anticipated.
The restaurant was accommodating and meals were prompt and tasty.

Gracious hosts Cameron & David are thrilled to talk with guests and they even arranged a motorbike tour through remote villages & rice fields, past temples & waterfalls.  We never did this before so it was quite a treat.  My only complaint is, nothing to do with Bali Lush, we should have stayed longer!

Our eco retreat in Bali offers three gorgeous free-standing bungalows that include a perfect fusion of Indonesian architecture and modern western comforts. While we are passionate about providing an authentic experience, we don’t believe you have to sacrifice the comforts of home. Our bungalows, cottages and rooms make sure you don’t have to.

A selection of 5 to 6 menu items is available each day. The menu changes daily based on what is in season and growing in our gardens. Explore our sample menu, and if you see something you would like during your stay with us, just let us know, and we will make it for you. We want you to be happy at Bali Lush and will always accommodate your requests if we can do so.

When you need a break from relaxation, and want to get out there and do something, we offer a breath of activities. From outdoor hikes and waterfall explorations, to crafting and cooking lessons, trips to local markets, motorbike excursions and a range of unique guided tours.
